title: API returns timestamps without a timezone; browsers in IST show times 5h30 off
body:
**Severity:** medium. Customers in India (and anywhere not UTC) see wrong times on every list and detail page.

**Root cause.** `created_at` / `last_updated` are `timestamp without time zone` columns written in UTC. The API serialises them with no offset (e.g. `2026-11-11T11:50:35.700704`). The browser parses an offset-less ISO string as **local** time.

**Reproduction.** Staging scan 109 was created at 17:20 IST. Parsed with Node under `TZ=Asia/Kolkata` it shows `11:50 am IST`; under `TZ=UTC` it shows `05:20 pm IST`. Our CI and browser QA run in UTC, so they never see it.

**Fix.** Serialise every datetime as UTC with an explicit `Z`/`+00:00` (one place: the response encoder or a Pydantic type), or move the columns to `timestamptz`. Add an API test asserting the offset, and run one browser QA pass with `timezoneId: 'Asia/Kolkata'`.

Found by the content-accuracy review of PR #38 (review 5858670025). Evidence scripts: session scratchpad `round6/rv-content38-probe/`.
